paper.title_en: Logarithmic corrections to the entropy of near-extremal rotating black holes
paper.abstract_en: An interesting feature of quantum corrections to the Bekenstein--Hawking entropy is the appearance of logarithmic area terms, whose coefficients are governed by the spectrum of massless fields. For near-extremal black holes, the entropy also receives a logarithmic temperature correction, whose coefficient is determined by the zero modes of the corresponding extremal black holes. In this paper, we study near-extremal rotating black holes in three, four, and five dimensions with an important focus on rotational zero modes. For three-dimensional BTZ black holes, our results are in agreement with the microscopic description. Furthermore, by treating the cosmological constant scale \(\ell\) as an independent parameter, we find an additional \(\log \ell\) correction to the entropy at extremality. For the five-dimensional BMPV black hole, we explicitly construct all the extremal zero modes and use them to evaluate the log temperature corrections to the entropy.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文深入研究近极端旋转黑洞熵的对数修正，聚焦于旋转零模，结果与微观描述一致，并发现新的对数修正，具有理论深度和新颖性。
decision.title_zh: 近极端旋转黑洞熵的对数修正
decision.abstract_zh: 贝肯斯坦-霍金熵的量子修正的一个有趣特征是对数面积项的出现，其系数由无质量场的谱决定。对于近极端黑洞，熵还接受一个对数温度修正，其系数由相应极端黑洞的零模决定。在本文中，我们研究三维、四维和五维中的近极端旋转黑洞，重点关注旋转零模。对于三维BTZ黑洞，我们的结果与微观描述一致。此外，通过将宇宙学常数尺度\(\ell\)视为独立参数，我们发现在极端情形下熵有一个额外的\(\log \ell\)修正。对于五维BMPV黑洞，我们明确构造所有极端零模，并使用它们评估熵的对数温度修正。
